question: How strong is Americo financially?
answer: Americo Financial Life and Annuity Insurance Company had an A.M. Best financial strength rating of A (Excellent) as of January 1, 2026 — the third of 15 A.M. Best categories. Company materials as of year-end 2025 cite about $10.44 billion in assets and $52.1 billion of insurance in force. Ratings and financials can change; Mejor Vida confirms current figures at the time of sale. Americo is not authorized in New York.

question: Are living benefits included on Americo term?
answer: On Americo Instant Decision Term 100, Term 125, CBO 50/100, and Continuation 10/25, living benefit riders for qualifying critical, chronic, or terminal illness are included at no extra premium. Using the benefit is a lump-sum acceleration of the death benefit (not a small rider check); an administrative charge and an actuarial discount apply, so the cash paid can be much less than the face amount — or even zero if life expectancy is long. Payment Protector is a different design (monthly income or lump sum) and those living-benefit riders are not listed on the Americo living-benefits flyer. Instant Decision IUL includes similar living benefits; using them typically ends the IUL policy.

question: ¿Americo incluye beneficios en vida en el temporal?
answer: En Term 100, Term 125, CBO 50/100 y Continuation 10/25 de Americo, los anexos de beneficio en vida por enfermedad crítica, crónica o terminal que califique van incluidos sin prima extra. Es un adelanto del beneficio por fallecimiento (no un cheque pequeño); hay cargo administrativo y descuento actuarial, así que el efectivo puede ser mucho menor que el monto — o cero si la expectativa de vida es larga. Payment Protector es otro diseño (renta mensual o un solo pago) y esos anexos no figuran en el folleto de beneficios en vida. El IUL Instant Decision incluye beneficios similares; usarlos suele terminar la póliza.
